Injector 3 driver: PAIR = in parallel with INJ2 on 2V (1989-93 stock harness, two injectors per wire); SEQ = its own wire 2Y (1994-95, or a 1989-93 sequential conversion). Shunt: 2.54 mm jumper cap (LCSC C5305), fitted by hand

Second fan relay output: 1R on 1990-93 (the 1990-91 A/C fan), 2S on 1994-95 (condenser fan). Shunt: 2.54 mm jumper cap (LCSC C5305), fitted by hand
Fit on 1994-95: the pressure regulator control solenoid on 2R. Leave open on 1989-93. Shunt: 2.54 mm jumper cap (LCSC C5305), fitted by hand

Leave OPEN with the stock igniter: it drives the tachometer and sends its signal to the ECU on 2I. Fit only after a coil-on-plug conversion with the igniter removed: the ECU then drives the tachometer through 2I (R37 is its 12 V pull-up; join the two tach wires at the old igniter plug). Shunt: 2.54 mm jumper cap (LCSC C5305), fitted by hand

Airflow meter signal wire 2O: AFM = to the spare analog input (stock); BOOST = boost valve output on that wire once the meter is removed (valve between the old meter plug's signal pin and 12 V). Shunt: 2.54 mm jumper cap (LCSC C5305), fitted by hand
